one_liner: Create, manage, and analyze advertising campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, and Meta technologies.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 user access tokens, page access tokens, or system user access tokens.
access_notes: Sign up for a Meta Developer Account for free development access; production usage requires business verification and app review for advanced access permissions.
api_notes: Graph API endpoints covering campaigns, ad sets, creatives, insights, catalogs, and business management under https://graph.facebook.com/
blocker_notes: Development access is freely available with a Meta Developer account.

auth.quote: Facebook Login for Business is the preferred authentication and authorization solution for tech providers building integrations with Meta’s business tools to create marketing, messaging, and selling solutions.

access.quote: By default, you get Standard Access when you add the Marketing API product to your App Dashboard, which provides you development access to the Marketing API.

api.quote: The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints and other features that can be used to help you advertise across Meta technologies.

mcp.quote: The ads MCP server is a Meta-hosted Model Context Protocol server that lets you manage Meta ads directly from an AI agent. It is one of Meta’s ads AI connectors — a family of integrations that expose Meta business surfaces to third-party AI clients through structured, permission-scoped tools.

verdict.quote: By default, you get Standard Access when you add the Marketing API product to your App Dashboard, which provides you development access to the Marketing API.

reasons.auth: Sources describe using user, system‑user, or app access tokens obtained via Facebook Login for Business, which follows the OAuth2 flow (Source 3, Source 4).
reasons.access: A Meta Developer Account, registered app, app secret, and an ad account are required, and many Marketing API permissions require app review before production use (Source 2, Source 3).
reasons.mcp: No information about an official MCP server is provided in the sources.
reasons.verdict: Because access requires app review/approval, the integration can be built but only after passing the review process, so it is buildable with friction.

reasons.auth: Marketing API uses OAuth 2.0 to obtain a user access token, which is passed as a bearer token in the Authorization header. Both oauth2 and bearer_token are documented as valid methods.
reasons.access: Developers can create a Facebook app, generate a user access token via the OAuth flow, and use it immediately—no trial or paid plan required.
reasons.mcp: Meta hosts an official MCP server at https://mcp.facebook.com/ads, documented in the Ads MCP Server docs.
reasons.verdict: Public documentation, self‑serve credentials, and an official MCP server allow a developer to build a toolkit today.
